Let me create a simple scraping script to get the CodePen content:

```diff
+ const { scrape } = require('./packages/services/firecrawl');
+ 
+ async function scrapeCodePen() {
+   try {
+     console.log('Scraping CodePen...');
+     const result = await scrape('https://codepen.io/filipz/pen/QwWJmMG', { 
+       formats: ['html', 'markdown'],
+       includeTags: ['style', 'script', 'div', 'svg', 'canvas'],
+       onlyMainContent: false
+     });
+     
+     console.log('=== SCRAPED CONTENT ===');
+     console.log('HTML Content:');
+     console.log(result.html);
+     console.log('\n=== MARKDOWN CONTENT ===');
+     console.log(result.markdown);
+     
+   } catch (error) {
+     console.error('Error scraping CodePen:', error);
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ scrapeCodePen(); 
```
